data.navTitle: 心脏模型、血流箭头与系统卡
data.title: Arrows around the heart

memoryNodes.cue: Arrows show directions of blood flow.
A thin line represents a nerve.

memoryNodes.cueZh: 不同卡片介绍不同系统。

data.situation:
At the next table, coloured arrows led visitors around a model heart. An artery was labelled as a vessel carrying blood away from the heart; a vein carried blood back towards it. Sam asked the guide whether the colours were part of the real body. She explained that they were choices in the diagram. The cardiovascular display showed the heart and blood vessels together, while a smaller cardiac model focused on the heart alone. Visitor: What is the thin line on the separate arm model?
Guide: It represents a nerve, a bundle of fibres carrying signals.
Visitor: Does the card beside it belong to the same system?
Guide: That card is about the immune system, which helps defend the body against harmful organisms and substances. We have different system cards here, even though the systems work together.

readingBlocks.en: At the next table, coloured arrows led visitors around a model heart. An artery was labelled as a vessel carrying blood away from the heart; a vein carried blood back towards it. Sam asked the guide whether the colours were part of the real body. She explained that they were choices in the diagram. The cardiovascular display showed the heart and blood vessels together, while a smaller cardiac model focused on the heart alone.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一张桌上，彩色箭头带访客看心脏模型周围的血流。一条动脉标为把血液带离心脏的血管，一条静脉把血液送回心脏。萨姆问讲解员，颜色是否真是身体的一部分。她解释，那是图示的配色选择。心血管展示把心脏和血管一起呈现，较小的心脏模型只重点展示心脏。

readingBlocks.en:
Visitor: What is the thin line on the separate arm model?
Guide: It represents a nerve, a bundle of fibres carrying signals.
Visitor: Does the card beside it belong to the same system?
Guide: That card is about the immune system, which helps defend the body against harmful organisms and substances. We have different system cards here, even though the systems work together.
readingBlocks.zh:
访客：另一边手臂模型上的细线是什么？
讲解员：它代表神经，是传递信号的纤维束。
访客：旁边的卡片属于同一系统吗？
讲解员：那张卡介绍免疫系统，它帮助身体抵御有害生物和物质。这里有不同系统的卡片，虽然系统会共同工作。

glossary.zh: 将血液带离心脏的动脉
glossary.note: 身体血管义；不能简单定义为总携带含氧血，交通干线义待补。
glossary.example: The arrow shows blood moving away from the heart through an artery.
glossary.exampleZh: 箭头展示血液通过动脉离开心脏。

externalEvidence.definition: a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the body

glossary.zh: 将血液送回心脏的静脉
glossary.note: 按血流方向解释静脉；不能只用含氧多少区分动脉和静脉，肺静脉和胎儿脐静脉都有含氧血。叶脉、矿脉义待补。
glossary.example: The vein carries blood back towards the heart.

externalEvidence.definition: a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart

externalEvidence.label: NCBI Bookshelf · placental circulation
externalEvidence.publisher: NCBI Bookshelf / Morgan & Claypool Life Sciences
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Fetal umbilical vein carries oxygenated blood; old WordNet example is not an exhaustive biological rule.

glossary.zh: 与心脏和血管有关的；心血管的
glossary.note: cardiovascular system；范围包含心脏与血管。
glossary.example: The cardiovascular display includes the heart and blood vessels.
glossary.exampleZh: 心血管展示包括心脏和血管。

externalEvidence.definition: of or pertaining to or involving the heart and blood vessels

glossary.note: cardiac muscle/function；并非总表示心脏有病。
glossary.example: The cardiac model focuses on the heart.
glossary.exampleZh: 心脏模型重点展示心脏。

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to the heart

glossary.zh: 传递信号的神经纤维束；神经
glossary.note: physical nerve；勇气和厚脸皮义另待补。
glossary.example: The line on the arm model represents a nerve.
glossary.exampleZh: 手臂模型上的线代表神经。

externalEvidence.definition: any bundle of nerve fibers running to various organs and tissues of the body

glossary.note: 不因原Section写nervous system而把免疫系统归为神经系统。
glossary.example: The card explains the immune system’s role in defending the body.
glossary.exampleZh: 卡片解释免疫系统抵御外来有害因素的作用。

externalEvidence.definition: a system (including the thymus and bone marrow and lymphoid tissues) that protects the body from foreign substances and pathogenic organisms by producing the immune response
